definition: Take off means to remove something from your body or to leave the ground and begin to fly.
usage_note: It has several meanings, and the exact meaning depends on the context.

examples.sentence: Please take off your shoes before coming inside.
The plane took off on time despite the rain.
Her small business really took off last year.
